producedBy.independence: Engine source (packages/astrodynamics) not read and engine not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value (ECMA-262 Number::toString); JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

method.elementToState: Regular map, no special cases (contracts-v1.md §3): p = a(1 − e²), r = p/(1 + e cos ν), perifocal r = r(cos ν, sin ν, 0), v = √(μ/p)(−sin ν, e + cos ν, 0), rotated by Q = Rz(Ω)·Rx(i)·Rz(ω) formed as explicit products of the three active elementary rotation matrices.
method.stateToElements: In-plane polar formulation: h = r × v; i = atan2(√(h_x² + h_y²), h_z); Ω = atan2(h_x, −h_y); u = atan2(r·m̂, r·n̂) with n̂ = ẑ × h/|ẑ × h|, m̂ = ĥ × n̂; e cos ν = h²/(μr) − 1, e sin ν = h(r·v)/(μr); e = √(…); ν = atan2(e sin ν, e cos ν); ω = u − ν; a = 1/(2/r − v²/μ). atan2 only, no acos.

referenceAccuracy.bound: Same budget as the engine side (tolerances.md §7 VT-02): ‖δr‖ ≤ η_r(e)·u·r_a, ‖δv‖ ≤ η_v(e)·u·v_p
referenceAccuracy.measuredAgainst: The same map in 200-bit arithmetic with closed-form perifocal unit vectors (verification/src/hp/hp-kepler.ts hpElementsToState), from the same binary64 inputs.
